scenario_reading.trailing_120: read as the Syndra splinters option set to its cap (120 Splinters of Wrath). Sourced: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json calls the option 'splinters option (0-120)' and data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json says 'splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage'. 120 is also the exact wiki cap ('stacking up to 120 times').
scenario_reading.consequence: at 120 splinters ALL three Transcendent thresholds are live: 40 (second Dark Sphere charge / Q2 slot), 60 (W bonus true damage), 80 (E scatter angle+slow), 100 (R execute, documented not modeled), 120 (+15% AP).
scenario_reading.caveat: the scenario's own input tuple lives in scripts/ (out of scope for this oracle). If 'custom_order' means a literally user-supplied cast list, the golden is an echo of that list and no data-derived check is possible; the computation below is the derivation of the correct rotation order for Syndra at 120 splinters, which is what a rotation receipt must contain.

step_1_setup_consume_edges.claim: every Q cast precedes W, E and R, because W, E and R all consume/interact with the Dark Spheres that Q creates.
quotes: Q Dark Sphere (data/champions.json, Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[0].description): 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.'

W Force of Will (effects[0].description): 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location... She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then Dark Spheres.' -> in a manual-target 1v1 fight there are no minions/monsters, so W has no throwable object and no damage until a Dark Sphere exists.

E Scatter the Weak (effects[1].description): 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds... and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.' -> E interacts with spheres but does NOT double-dip damage.

R Unleashed Power (effects[1].description): 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.' -> R's damage is monotone in the number of live Q spheres (Minimum 240+60% AP at 3 spheres vs Maximum 560+140% AP at 7), so both Q charges must be spent before R.

step_2_two_q_casts_at_120_splinters.claim: at 120 splinters the rotation contains TWO Dark Sphere casts, so the third cast slot is no longer E.
quotes: Q Transcendent Bonus (data/champions.json, Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[1].description): 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
Q rechargeRate: [7,7,7,7,7]; cooldown.affectedByCdr: false (charge recharge, not a plain cooldown).
data/champion-audit/batch-6.json Syndra: modeled slots ['P','Q','Q2','W','E','R'], note 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)'; atoms include 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'.
data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json Syndra: '40+ Q charges via Q2 slot'.
step_2_two_q_casts_at_120_splinters.reasoning: Q2 is a modeled DAMAGE slot at >=40 splinters and the scenario sits at 120, so its damage is inside the fight total. A cast_order that omits it would be inconsistent with the damage it books. Both charges are stocked at fight start, and since Q is the sphere-application ability feeding W/E/R (step 1), both charges are spent before the consumers.

step_3_rank_the_consumers_by_dps.rule_quoted: data/worklists/f3-task.md (cached worklist): 'RANK per-rank DPS at the fight's stats for the remaining abilities (total_raw / effective cooldown x AoE weight)'; docs/math-foundations.md line 465 row 'Ability rotation casts (_schedule_shared_casts, _compute_ability_rotation) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT | ... R single-cast'; lines 57-68: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.'

sourced_numbers_max_rank.Q: 230 + 70% AP, cd 7 (affectedByCdr false; R passive additionally grants 10/20/30 AH to Q)
sourced_numbers_max_rank.W_at_>=60_splinters: wiki 'Total Mixed Damage' row = 212.8 + 76.6% AP (base 190 + 65% AP, plus the 60-splinter '12% (+2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage'), cd 8 at rank 5, affectedByCdr true
sourced_numbers_max_rank.R_rank_3: 80 + 20% AP per sphere; Minimum 240 + 60% AP (3 spheres), Maximum 560 + 140% AP (7 spheres), cd 80, affectedByCdr true

step_3_rank_the_consumers_by_dps.haste_invariance: W and E are both affectedByCdr, so any ability haste multiplies both effective cooldowns by the same 100/(100+AH) (docs/math-foundations.md: 'cd' = cd*100/(100+AH)'). W/E DPS ratio = 15*(212.8+0.766*AP) / (8*(200+0.6*AP)) = 1.99 (AP=0) to 2.29 (AP=1000) - W beats E at every AP, every rank pair (rank 1 check: 15*(78.4+0.742AP)/(12*(60+0.6AP)) = 1.63 down to 1.55, still >1), and every haste value. The 120-splinter passive (+15% AP) scales every ability's AP term identically and cannot reorder them.
step_3_rank_the_consumers_by_dps.conclusion: among the consumers W > E > R, and R is last on both DPS (lowest by an order of magnitude) and on the step-1 edge (it grabs up to 4 live spheres, so it wants every prior sphere on the ground).

derived_cast_order: Q2 (second Dark Sphere charge, 40-splinter Transcendent bonus)
independent_computation.why_old_value_is_wrong: E at index 2 is exactly the legacy fixed DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (Q, W, E, R) - a four-cast rotation that ignores the second Dark Sphere charge the scenario's 120-splinter setting unlocks. With both charges spent first (and they must be, since W, E and R all consume spheres), the third cast is the highest-DPS/highest-per-cast consumer, W.
independent_computation.residual_uncertainty: cast_order[2]=W is also what an (incorrect) E-before-W reorder [Q,E,W,R] would print. This receipt certifies the VALUE at index 2, and both the 5-cast derivation above and any correct ordering that keeps W ahead of E agree on W; only the omit-the-second-charge default order yields E. If the engine reached W via [Q,E,W,R] the leaf value is right for the wrong reason - a check of the full array (index 1 must be a Q cast, not E) belongs to the reviewer with source access.
